collection.title: MODIS/Terra Land Surface Temperature/Emissivity 8-Day L3 Global 6km SIN Grid V061
collection.summary: The Terra Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS) Land Surface Temperature/Emissivity 8-Day (MOD11B2) Version 6.1 product provides an average 8-day per pixel Land Surface Temperature and Emissivity (LST&E) in a 1,200 by 1,200 kilometer (km) tile with a pixel size of 5,600 meters (m). Each temperature and emissivity pixel value in the MOD11B2 is a simple average of all the corresponding values from the LST&E values from the [MOD11B1](https://doi.org/10.5067/MODIS/MOD11B1.061) product collected during that 8-day period. Each MOD11B2 granule consists of 19 layers including daytime and nighttime layers for LSTs, quality control assessments, observation times, view zenith angles, and number of clear sky observations along with percentage of land in the tile and emissivities from bands 20, 22, 23, 29, 31, and 32. Unique to the MOD11B products are additional day and night LST layers generated from band 31 of the corresponding 1 km [MOD11_L2](https://doi.org/10.5067/MODIS/MOD11_L2.061) swath product aggregated to the 6 km grid. Known Issues * For complete information about known issues please refer to the [MODIS/VIIRS Land Quality Assessment website](https://landweb.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/knownissue?sensor=MODIS&sat=Terra&as=61).

documentation.description: The technical information in the User's Guide enables users to interpret and use the data products.
The ATBD provides physical theory and mathematical procedures for the calculations used to produce the data products.
The File Specification provides a description of the product file including Scientific Data Sets and their attributes.
Validation at stage 2 has been achieved for all MODIS Land Surface Temperature and Emissivity products.
Further details regarding MODIS land product validation for the MOD11 data products are available from the MODIS Land Team Validation site.
The LDOPE Land Product Quality Assessment website provides known issues, maneuvers, and product quality of the land products.
